answer.answer: Under the national ration programme, Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families in the poorest entitlement tier receive 35 kilograms of foodgrains per family per month [E02], while Priority Household (PHH) beneficiaries in the priority tier receive 5 kilograms of foodgrains per person per month [E02].

claim_to_evidence.claim: AAY families receive 35 kilograms of foodgrains per family per month
PHH beneficiaries receive 5 kilograms of foodgrains per person per month
